title: ai-badger agent capability matrix
description: What each supported agent can do and how much of it ai-badger scaffolds. Lives at features/common/support.json. Keep agent keys in sync with agents.schema.json and badger_lib.py AGENT_NAMES.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date the matrix was last reviewed against the agents' actual behaviour.

agents.description: Keyed by agent name — the same keys config.agents accepts.

name.description: Display name of the agent product.

supported.description: Whether the agent itself has this capability: true, false, or "partial".

mechanism.description: How the agent exposes it; null when unsupported.

aiBadgerSupport.description: Whether ai-badger scaffolds anything for it. Never true when supported is false.

configPath.description: Project-relative file the capability is configured in.

scaffoldedFile.description: File ai-badger writes for this capability.

scaffoldedBy.description: Script and function that scaffolds it.

wiredBy.description: Script and function that registers it with the agent.

format.description: On-disk format when it is not implied by the mechanism — prose, or a shape sketch.
